elsewhere.note: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”
Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed…
concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,
But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.
